title: Declared input brief for real_research_task_v1
purpose: The declared input material for the real_research_task_v1 protocol. Its single `analysis` phase declares `inputs: [input-brief:real_research_v1]`; the composition root stores exactly these bytes under that artifact id, and the run chain registers the object as a NON-MODEL source whose digest is recomputable from this file (GOAL-010 EC-02).
what_this_is: An operator-supplied brief: it states the task, the deliverable expectation and the constraints.

It is NOT a retrieval result and does NOT contain literature citations -- real retrieval is not wired into the run chain yet (GOAL-010 EC-02 residual W-7), so claiming sources here would be fabrication.
what_this_proves: A verifiable grounding relation between the deliverable and the material the task was supplied with (the digest is recomputable from this file).
It does NOT prove the session actually read it -- only a tool observation could prove that, and tools in the live harness are currently inert.

documents.title: Task
documents.text: Analyse the supplied subject and produce a single structured analysis report: what the subject does, the assumptions it rests on, the conditions under which it fails, and what evidence would be needed to settle the open questions.

documents.title: Deliverable expectation
documents.text: One report under the contract-declared artifact name. The contract judges that the artifact exists and that coverage is satisfied by a non-model source; it deliberately does not judge the report's content quality, and that limit is stated rather than hidden.

documents.title: Constraints
documents.text: Single task, single deliverable, no retrieval: the protocol declares exactly what the system can execute today. Multi-phase and parallel research is a later protocol's problem, not something to assert here.
